preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p_i < i for i, p_i in enumerate(p, start=2))
preconditions.description: The parent array p must have exactly n-1 elements, where each p_i is a valid parent index for node i (1 ≤ p_i < i).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node <= n for node in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: All node labels are integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer modulo 998244353.
The output is the number of valid partitions of leaves into disjoint connected subgraphs, modulo 998244353, where count_valid_partitions(n, p) is the correct count for the given tree.
